_comment: Shadow-mode Jev classifier config. mode is overridden at runtime by PI_JEV_MODE=off|observe. Never set mode to anything that applies routing changes; this helper has no 'apply' mode. Pricing per TypeSafe's own docs (docs.typesafe.ai), not Pi's bundled catalog which under-reports this route as free -- see docs/research/jev-helper-implementation.md. Per-call budget reservation is computed from a conservative worst-case byte bound (MAX_TASK_CHARS + exact rubric size), not configurable here -- see worstCaseRequestBytes() in config/pi/lib/jev.mjs. A config that fails validation (bad types, out-of-range numbers, unknown classes, timeoutMs above the hard 5000ms ceiling) makes every call abstain with status:'skipped' rather than silently falling back to defaults.
